entities.name: Lidia Gueiler Tejada
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lydia Gueiler Tejada was a Bolivian politician who served as the 56th president of Bolivia from 1979 to 1980. She was one of the first female republican heads of state and the first woman to serve as president of Bolivia.
